warningMessages.DOCUMENT_LAYERS_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM 未暴露文档图层，当前预览或导出无法完整遍历 PSD 图层。
warningMessages.PSD_NO_TARGET_ROOT_FALLBACK: 未找到配置的根 TargetType 分组，已按 rootPolicy.noTargetFallback 生成临时目标。
warningMessages.PSD_UNMARKED_ROOT_IGNORED: 根图层或根分组没有配置的 TargetType 标记，已按根策略忽略。
warningMessages.PSD_NO_EXPORTABLE_ROOT_TARGET: 没有找到可导出的根目标。请给 PSD 顶层分组添加配置中的 TargetType 标记。
warningMessages.PSD_FLAG_CONTEXT_INVALID: 命名标记使用位置不符合当前配置规则。请检查该图层/分组的标记上下文。
warningMessages.PSD_PREFAB_REF_CHILDREN_SKIPPED: 该节点类型配置为跳过子树，子图层不会继续展开到 BUI。
warningMessages.PSD_LISTITEM_TARGET_GENERATED: ListItem 占位已按配置生成为独立 target，并在父 List 中生成 PrefabRef 挂载点。
warningMessages.PSD_COMPONENT_TARGET_GENERATED: Page 内嵌 Component 已按配置生成为独立 target，并在 Page 原位置生成 PrefabRef 挂载点。
warningMessages.PSD_DUPLICATE_TARGET_NAME: 发现重复 target 名称。@Page_ / @Popup_ / @Component_ / @ListItem_ 的目标名必须唯一。
warningMessages.PREVIEW_WARNINGS_TRUNCATED: 面板预览中的 warning 显示被截断；实际导出会保留完整 warnings。
warningMessages.PREVIEW_NODE_LIMIT_REACHED: BUI 结构预览达到面板节点显示上限；实际导出仍会继续遍历完整 PSD。
warningMessages.PSD_FILE_ENTRY_NOT_SELECTED: 导出已阻断：UXP 未授权当前 PSD 文件 Entry，无法记录 psdSha256、psdSize 和 psdModifiedAt。
warningMessages.PSD_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: UXP 无法读取 PSD 文件元数据。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_SHA256_UNAVAILABLE: UXP 无法读取 PSD 字节来计算 sha256。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.CANVAS_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM 未暴露有效画布宽高。
warningMessages.PSD_LISTITEM_TARGET_CONTEXT_MISSING: ListItem 占位需要 target 集合上下文，但当前导出流程没有提供该上下文。
warningMessages.PSD_COMPONENT_TARGET_CONTEXT_MISSING: 内嵌 Component 需要 target 集合上下文，但当前导出流程没有提供该上下文。
warningMessages.LAYER_PNG_EXPORT_NO_ASSETS_FOLDER: assets 目录不可用，已跳过该图层 PNG 切图。
warningMessages.HIDDEN_LAYER_PNG_SKIPPED: 隐藏图层会保留在 BUI 中，但已跳过 PNG 切图。
warningMessages.EMPTY_LAYER_PNG_SKIPPED: 图层边界为空或不可读，已跳过 PNG 切图。
warningMessages.LAYER_PNG_EXPORT_FAILED: UXP 导出该图层 PNG 失败。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.TEXT_STYLE_UNCERTAIN: 文本样式为部分读取；视觉有效字号可用时会写入 BUI，字体、颜色、字距、行距、对齐和其余 TMP 映射仍需后续 UXP/batchPlay 覆盖或人工确认。
warningMessages.TEXT_FONT_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM 未暴露可用文本字号；除非手工修正 BUI，TMP FontSize 会保留默认值。
warningMessages.SMART_OBJECT_UNCERTAIN: 智能对象来源、变换和嵌入内容在第一版中不会序列化，需要后续确认。
warningMessages.ASSET_SHA256_UNAVAILABLE: PNG 已导出，但当前 UXP 环境无法计算 sha256；导出会被 BUI 自检阻断。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.BUI_ASSETS_EXPORT_SKIPPED: 本次只导出 BUI，未切 PNG，也未修改 assets 目录；仅当旧 BUI 和旧 PNG 资源完整时才会复用资源引用。
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_APPLIED: 本次只导出 BUI，并成功复用了旧 BUI/旧 PNG 的资源引用。
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_PARTIAL: 本次只导出 BUI，但只有部分资源引用可安全复用；不能直接 Make Prefab，请重新勾选切 PNG 资源。
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_UNAVAILABLE: 本次只导出 BUI，但旧 BUI 或旧 PNG 资源不完整，无法复用资源引用；该产物适合结构或诊断检查，不适合直接 Make Prefab。
warningMessages.DOCUMENT_PREVIEW_ASSET_EXPORTED: 已导出整页合成预览 PNG 作为第一版辅助产物；逐图层 PNG 切图仍以切图计划为准。
warningMessages.DOCUMENT_PREVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED: UXP 导出整页合成预览 PNG 失败。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.BUI_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_ONLY: 当前插件会执行轻量 required/type 自检，但不会在 UXP 沙盒内执行完整 JSON Schema 校验，也不会修改 schema。
warningMessages.BUI_SCHEMA_CHECKLIST_FAILED: BUI 导出前自检未通过。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.BUI_TEXT_KEY_SEED_REVIEW: 静态 NoBind Text 无法推导出非空 LanguageKey；仍允许导出，生成组件会保留空 LanguageKey，请在后续确认或修正。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.UXP_FIELD_COVERAGE_FIRST_PASS: layer id、文本样式、蒙版、图层效果和智能对象在第一版中属于尽力读取或未知字段，会记录为 warnings，不作为可信事实。
warningMessages.PSD_NAMING_RULES_CONFIG_LOAD_FAILED: 命名规则配置读取失败，已使用内置兜底规则。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_IGNORE_MARK_APPLIED: 图层或分组命中忽略前缀，已连同整个子树一起跳过。
warningMessages.PSD_UNKNOWN_MAIN_FLAG: 发现未知主标记，已仅保留在 sourcePath 中，不影响导出语义。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_UNKNOWN_OPTION_FLAG: 发现未知选项标记，已仅保留在 sourcePath 中，不影响导出语义。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_MULTIPLE_MAIN_FLAGS: 同一图层/分组存在多个主标记，导出器只使用其中一个，其余会被忽略。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_ASSET_OPTION_INVALID: 资源类型选项不适用于当前节点类型。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_LAYOUT_OPTION_INVALID: 布局选项不适用于当前节点类型。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_NINESLICE_OPTION_INVALID: 九宫选项不适用于当前节点类型。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.PSD_OPTION_PARAMS_INVALID: 选项参数格式不符合配置要求。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.LAYER_BOUNDS_UNAVAILABLE: UXP 无法读取图层边界。原始信息：{original}
warningMessages.LAYER_ID_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM 未暴露 layer id，导出器已使用 sourcePath hash 作为节点 id 兜底。
warningMessages.LAYER_MASK_UNCERTAIN: 检测到图层蒙版或矢量蒙版，但第一版不会序列化蒙版几何信息。
warningMessages.LAYER_EFFECTS_UNCERTAIN: 检测到 Photoshop 图层效果，但第一版不会序列化可直接用于 Unity 的效果数据。

warningMessages.DOCUMENT_LAYERS_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM did not expose document layers.
warningMessages.PSD_NO_TARGET_ROOT_FALLBACK: No configured root target group was found. The exporter used the rootPolicy.noTargetFallback target.
warningMessages.PSD_UNMARKED_ROOT_IGNORED: Root layer/group has no configured TargetType flag and was ignored by the configured root policy.
warningMessages.PSD_NO_EXPORTABLE_ROOT_TARGET: No exportable root target was found. Add a configured TargetType flag to a top-level PSD group.
warningMessages.PSD_FLAG_CONTEXT_INVALID: A naming flag is not valid in this context.
warningMessages.PSD_PREFAB_REF_CHILDREN_SKIPPED: Configured node type skips its child subtree.
warningMessages.PSD_LISTITEM_TARGET_GENERATED: Configured ListItem placeholder is shown as a generated target plus a PrefabRef mount in the parent List.
warningMessages.PSD_COMPONENT_TARGET_GENERATED: Component child Prefab under Page is shown as a generated target plus a PrefabRef mount in the Page.
warningMessages.PSD_DUPLICATE_TARGET_NAME: Duplicate target name found. @Page_ / @Popup_ / @Component_ / @ListItem_ target names must be unique.
warningMessages.PREVIEW_WARNINGS_TRUNCATED: Preview warnings were omitted from the panel preview. The real export will keep full warnings.
warningMessages.PREVIEW_NODE_LIMIT_REACHED: BUI preview reached the panel node display limit. The real export will continue traversing the full PSD.
warningMessages.PSD_FILE_ENTRY_NOT_SELECTED: Export was blocked because UXP has not authorized the current PSD file entry, so psdSha256, psdSize and psdModifiedAt cannot be recorded.
warningMessages.PSD_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: UXP could not read PSD metadata. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_SHA256_UNAVAILABLE: UXP could not read PSD bytes for sha256. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.CANVAS_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM did not expose a valid canvas width or height.
warningMessages.PSD_LISTITEM_TARGET_CONTEXT_MISSING: Configured list-item placeholder requires target collection context, but the exporter did not provide it.
warningMessages.PSD_COMPONENT_TARGET_CONTEXT_MISSING: Component child Prefab requires target collection context, but the exporter did not provide it.
warningMessages.LAYER_PNG_EXPORT_NO_ASSETS_FOLDER: Layer PNG export skipped because assets folder is unavailable.
warningMessages.HIDDEN_LAYER_PNG_SKIPPED: Hidden layer node is kept in BUI but PNG slicing was skipped.
warningMessages.EMPTY_LAYER_PNG_SKIPPED: Layer bounds are empty or unavailable, so PNG slicing was skipped.
warningMessages.LAYER_PNG_EXPORT_FAILED: UXP could not export this layer PNG. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.TEXT_STYLE_UNCERTAIN: Text style export is partial. Effective font size is written to BUI when available; font, color, tracking, leading, alignment and remaining TMP mapping need later UXP/batchPlay coverage or manual confirmation.
warningMessages.TEXT_FONT_SIZE_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM did not expose a usable Text font size. TMP FontSize will keep its default unless BUI is fixed manually.
warningMessages.SMART_OBJECT_UNCERTAIN: Smart object source, transforms and placed content are not serialized in the first pass.
warningMessages.ASSET_SHA256_UNAVAILABLE: The PNG was exported, but the current UXP environment could not compute sha256. The BUI checklist will block export. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.BUI_ASSETS_EXPORT_SKIPPED: This run exported BUI only, skipped PNG slicing, and did not modify the assets folder. Existing resource references are reused only when the previous BUI and PNG assets are complete.
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_APPLIED: This BUI-only export reused resource references from the previous BUI and existing PNG assets.
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_PARTIAL: This BUI-only export could safely reuse only part of the resource references; it cannot directly Make Prefab, re-enable PNG slicing first.
warningMessages.BUI_ASSET_REUSE_UNAVAILABLE: This BUI-only export could not reuse resource references because the previous BUI or PNG assets are incomplete. Use it for structure or diagnostics, not Make Prefab.
warningMessages.DOCUMENT_PREVIEW_ASSET_EXPORTED: A composite document preview PNG was exported as a first-pass asset. Per-layer PNG slicing is still pending.
warningMessages.DOCUMENT_PREVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED: UXP could not export the document composite PNG. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.BUI_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_ONLY: The plugin runs a lightweight required/type checklist, but does not run full JSON Schema validation inside the UXP sandbox.
warningMessages.BUI_SCHEMA_CHECKLIST_FAILED: BUI pre-export checklist failed. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.BUI_TEXT_KEY_SEED_REVIEW: Static NoBind Text could not derive a non-empty LanguageKey. Export remains allowed and the generated component will keep LanguageKey empty; confirm or fix it later. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.UXP_FIELD_COVERAGE_FIRST_PASS: layer id, text style, masks, layer effects and smart objects are best-effort or unknown in this first pass and are recorded as warnings instead of trusted facts.
warningMessages.PSD_NAMING_RULES_CONFIG_LOAD_FAILED: Naming rules config could not be loaded; built-in fallback rules were used. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_IGNORE_MARK_APPLIED: Layer or group starts with the configured ignore prefix and was skipped with its whole subtree.
warningMessages.PSD_UNKNOWN_MAIN_FLAG: Unknown main naming flag was kept in sourcePath only and did not affect export semantics. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_UNKNOWN_OPTION_FLAG: Unknown option naming flag was kept in sourcePath only and did not affect export semantics. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_MULTIPLE_MAIN_FLAGS: Multiple main flags were found; the exporter used one and ignored the rest. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_ASSET_OPTION_INVALID: Asset option is not valid on the current node type. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_LAYOUT_OPTION_INVALID: Layout option is not valid on the current node type. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_NINESLICE_OPTION_INVALID: Nine-slice option is not valid on the current node type. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.PSD_OPTION_PARAMS_INVALID: Option parameters do not match the configured format. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.LAYER_BOUNDS_UNAVAILABLE: UXP could not read layer bounds. Original message: {original}
warningMessages.LAYER_ID_UNAVAILABLE: Photoshop DOM did not expose a layer id. Exporter used a sourcePath hash for node id fallback.
warningMessages.LAYER_MASK_UNCERTAIN: Layer mask or vector mask presence was detected, but mask geometry is not serialized in the first pass.
warningMessages.LAYER_EFFECTS_UNCERTAIN: Photoshop layer effects were detected, but Unity-ready effect data is not serialized in the first pass.

en.previewEmpty: Open a PSD in Photoshop, then click Refresh to sync the current tab.
en.previewNoLayers: No analyzable layers were read from the current PSD.
en.previewPlanEmpty: Open a PSD and click Refresh to see the export summary.
en.previewPlanSummaryHint: Node tree and sliced assets are shown on the left
en.previewSlicePlanTitle: Slice plan (PSD path → output PNG → type/size)
en.previewNoSlices: No PNG slices are planned by the current rules.
en.previewSlicesUnavailable: Preflight detected {count} planned PNG files, but the preview list is not readable. Check resource nodes in the structure tree.
en.previewSlicesMore: {count} more PNG files are not shown.
en.previewWarningsEmpty: No blocking issue is currently detected.
en.previewCopyEmpty: No BUI structure preview is available to copy.
en.warningsCopyEmpty: No PSD conversion status is available to copy.
en.warningsCopyFailed: Failed to copy PSD conversion status: {error}
en.clipboardUnavailable: The current UXP host does not expose a clipboard API.
en.summaryTitle: Export status: waiting for current PSD
en.summaryBody: Exports to the current PSD folder and writes BUI, assets, warnings and a full-document preview.
en.summaryWaitingTitle: Export status: waiting for current PSD
en.summaryWaitingBody: Exports to the current PSD folder and writes BUI, assets, warnings and a full-document preview.
en.summaryReadyBody: The plugin will create the BUI file and assets folder from export settings.
en.summaryExportedBody: The BUI file and assets folder were written to the output folder.
en.summaryExportedBuiOnlyBody: The BUI file was written to the output folder; PNG slicing and assets folder changes were skipped.
en.folderHelp: Manual folder selection is not supported. BUI and assets are always written to the current PSD folder, with relative resource references.
en.baseHelp: Editable. Creates <name>.bui and <name>_bui_assets; suffixes come from config/export-settings.json.
en.processBody: Build BUI JSON from naming rules; slice assets PNGs when the PNG option is checked.
en.coverageHelp: Layer slicing duplicates layers into temporary documents and does not save or rewrite the active PSD. Text style, masks, layer effects and smart objects are still recorded as confirmation warnings.
en.sliceAssetsExportHelp: Needed for Make Prefab; uncheck to export BUI only.
en.namingHelp: UXP uses bundled CCX rules; Unity project rules are selected in Ember PSD settings.
en.namingRulesBody: UXP uses the full naming rules bundled in the current CCX and does not read a Unity project or Prefab Library Catalog. Unity projects select a standalone naming-rules JSON in Ember PSD Project Settings for project Skills and Unity-side Make Prefab validation.
en.docNoneMeta: Open a PSD in Photoshop first
en.docMetaUnknown: Document is open, but canvas or layer info is unavailable
en.psdOpenUnavailable: The current Photoshop UXP host does not expose app.open; file access was granted, but the plugin will not fake a document switch.
en.refreshSkippedDuringExport: Export is running; automatic refresh was skipped.
en.documentFolderAutoFailed: Could not automatically use the current PSD folder: {error}
en.documentFolderAutoUnavailable: The current UXP host cannot convert the PSD path into a writable folder. Choose the output folder manually.
en.outputFolderAuthorizationRequired: The export folder was derived from the current PSD path, but Photoshop UXP has not granted write access to it.
en.noDocumentFolderPath: The current PSD has no readable local path. Save it to local disk, then refresh and export again.
en.overwriteBody: Continuing will overwrite the BUI file. If the matching assets folder exists, PNG files will be updated individually: unchanged PNG files are kept, and stale assets no longer referenced by the current BUI are removed.
en.overwriteBodyBuiOnly: Continuing will overwrite the BUI file only. The matching assets folder will not be cleared or modified.
en.confirmNativeFailed: System confirmation dialog is unavailable; using the in-panel confirmation instead: {error}
en.exportCancelled: Export cancelled. Existing files were not overwritten.
en.buiPathIsFolder: The BUI output path is occupied by a folder: {name}
en.deleteEntryUnavailable: Photoshop UXP did not provide a delete API for: {name}
en.creatingAssets: Creating assets folder, slices and preview...
en.creatingBuiOnly: Exporting BUI with PNG slicing skipped...
en.sliceDoneDetailed: Slicing complete: {success} succeeded, {skipped} failed or skipped, {planned} planned in preflight.
en.sliceSkippedForBuiOnly: BUI-only mode: all PNG slicing was skipped.
en.assetsExportSkipped: Skipped assets folder creation, cleanup and PNG slicing.
en.sourceMetadataRequired: PSD source metadata is incomplete; export was blocked: {fields}. Save the PSD to local disk, refresh, and export again.
en.buiExportBlocked: BUI pre-export checklist found {count} blocking issue(s): {codes}
en.structureTreeTitleWithCounts: Prefab Node Tree · Prefabs {targets} · Prefab refs {prefabRefs}
en.resourceFileNameHint: PNG filenames use UI_<Module>_<AssetName>; duplicates get _01, _02 and later indexes.
en.structurePreviewSummary: Prefabs {targets} · Nodes {nodes} · Prefab refs {prefabRefs} · Planned slices {resources}
en.previewResourceEmpty: No PNG asset is exportable under the current rules.
en.overwriteNoConflict: Overwrite check complete: no matching BUI file or assets folder.
en.overwriteNoConflictBuiOnly: Overwrite check complete: no matching BUI file. The assets folder was not checked and will not be modified.
en.overwritePromptShown: Matching export output was found; waiting for overwrite confirmation: {items}
en.overwriteConfirmVisible: Overwrite confirmation is visible. Choose Cancel or Overwrite and Export.
en.exportAlreadyRunning: An export is already running. Wait for the current task to finish.
en.folderPickerOpeningAt: Trying to open the output folder picker from the current folder: {path}
en.folderPickerInitialLocationUnavailable: The current folder is known, but UXP has not authorized it as the picker start location: {path}
en.folderPickerInitialLocationFailed: The current UXP host rejected this folder as the picker start location. Falling back to the default location: {error}
en.outputFolderAutoTimeout: Auto-authorizing the current PSD folder timed out. Manual folder selection is not available in this version.
en.documentFolderAutoTimeout: Auto-reading the current PSD folder timed out. Make sure the PSD is saved to local disk.
en.psdFileAutoTimeout: Timed out while reading current PSD file access.
en.psdFileAutoFailed: Could not read current PSD file info automatically: {error}
en.sliceFileNamePrefixHelp: Remembered per PSD automatically. Example: UIV1_. Empty omits the fixed header. Changing it requires PNG export.
en.invalidSliceFileNamePrefix: Slice prefix allows up to 32 letters, digits or underscores; paths and spaces are not allowed.
en.slicePrefixRequiresPngExport: The slice prefix differs from the previous BUI. Enable PNG slicing before exporting; the existing BUI and PNG files were preserved.
en.retainReuseHelp: Unchecked exports the current PSD independently. Checked validates selected relations against current layers.
en.prefixSaveFailed: Prefix save failed: {error}. Current input is still usable.
en.prefixReadFailed: Prefix settings could not be fully read: {error}. Check the current prefix.
en.prefixRestoredsaved: Restored the saved prefix for this PSD.
en.prefixRestoredbui: Restored the prefix from this PSD’s previous BUI.
en.prefixRestoreddefault: No saved prefix for this PSD; using the default.
en.prefixInvalid: Invalid prefix; not saved. Use at most 32 letters, digits or underscores.
en.prefixUnsavedPsd: Save the PSD first so its prefix can be remembered by path.
